articles.summary: New daily route builds on JetBlue’s Fort Lauderdale growth and adds more choice between South Florida and Colombia To celebrate the launch, limited one-way fares are available starting at $134 in Main and $234 in EvenMore only at jetblue.com JetBlue (NASDAQ: JBLU) launched today its new daily nonstop service between Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) and Ernesto Cortissoz International Airport (BAQ) in Barranquilla, Colombia. The new service gives customers more choice and convenient travel options between South Florida and Colombia’s Caribbean coast. Barranquilla joins Medellín and Cartagena in JetBlue’s Colombian network, with service to Cali (CLO) set to launch later this month. Together, the new routes will bring JetBlue’s Colombian network to four destinations and further strengthen Fort Lauderdale’s role as a key gateway connecting customers across the United States, Latin America and the Caribbean. articles.title: JetBlue Expands in Colombia as New Nonstop Service to Barranquilla Takes Flight

articles.summary: New partnership expands JetBlue’s commitment to Boston with game-day experiences, digital content and new opportunities connecting the airline with Boston College fans, alumni, students and athletes JetBlue (NASDAQ: JBLU) today announced a new partnership with Boston College Athletics, becoming the Official Airline of Boston College Athletics and further strengthening the airline’s ties to the Boston community. “Boston has been part of JetBlue’s story for more than two decades, and our partnership with Boston College is another exciting way for us to show up for the communities and fans who make this city special,” said Stephanie Evans Greene, senior vice president, marketing and brand at JetBlue and Boston College alumna. “The pride, passion and sense of community at BC are truly special, and I’m happy to see JetBlue become part of that. articles.title: JetBlue Takes Flight with Boston College Athletics as Official Airline Partner
